title: Works OK but not Awesome
text: Works OK but not Awesome. I like that it saves wear on my bad shoulder. It gets stuck almost every time we use it under my kitchen island, under my bathroom vanity, etc....Also it gets my hair, string, fibers anything it picks up stuck around rollers constantly. We got it in October and used it the first month twice a week. You still have to move furniture/chairs toys if you want them swept properly underneath. I hardly ever use it anywhere but my kitchen anymore. It doesn't get close enough to baseboards and corners to keep dust and dirt from collecting there. I guess if it sounds too good to be true it is. My techy Teenage grandson has tried to block out the problem areas but it still is not a perfect science. LOL It also misses a lot of dirt on my carpet. Not great for thick plush carpet at all.

description: Forget about vacuuming for months at a time, with the Roomba i6+ robot vacuum that returns to the Clean Base Automatic Dirt Disposal and empties itself into Dirt Disposal bags that hold up to 60 days of dirt and dust. The i6+ learns your cleaning habits and can offer up personalized schedules, giving you one less thing to think about. During allergy season and peak pet-shedding times, it’ll suggest extra cleanings to make your life easier. When you’re ready to clean, use the iRobot Home App or just say the word—Google Assistant and Alexa can tell your robot to clean with just the sound of your voice. Guided by cutting-edge vSLAM navigation, the i6+ uses 10X Power-Lifting Suction* and Dual Multi-Surface Rubber Brushes for an impressive clean that’s truly effortless. *(compared to the Roomba 600 series cleaning system) *(Alexa and all related logos are trademarks of Amazon.com or its affiliates.
